cs.t: Full size hifi with Linn turntable and moving coil in the main room that is still first choice for music. I got the turntable before records became quite so rare but I have hundreds of them, so I'm glad I did. Not sure I'd buy as expensive if buying now. :) Denon mini hifi + Wharfedale bookshelf speakers for the computer room. Great value and sound for not too much money, with a Cd, pretty decent streaming player and FM/DAB tuner. Doesn't have a vinyl preamp though. For records for rather less try and grab a listen to a Rega Planar 1 that's remarkably solid for the money, and won a few awards.
